name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Clip
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a lightweight, sturdy, and charming decorative finish.
    - Made with a 1-layer wooden panel attached to a functional hardwood clip for both display and practical use.
    - The wooden panel has a 2mm thickness, creating a slim yet durable personalized accent piece.
    - The clip is made from hardwood and fitted with a galvanized coil-resistant spring for reliable holding strength.
    - Designed to combine cute custom decoration with practical clipping functionality.
    - Suitable for personal use, gifting, party favors, classroom décor, and themed accessories.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Wooden clip size:
               +) Length: 7.3 cm ~ 2.87 in
               +) Width: 1 cm ~ 0.39 in
               +) Depth: 1.2 cm ~ 0.47 in
    - Wooden panel size:
               +) Width: 1.5 in ~ 3.81 cm
               +) Height: 3 in ~ 7.62 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports single-sided printing on the wooden panel.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative clip and a personalized accessory.
    - Designed for clipping notes, photos, cards, gift bags, snack bags, party favors, or lightweight decorative items.
    - Suitable for classrooms, desks, party setups, gifts, souvenirs, and themed event decoration.
    - The hardwood clip with galvanized spring helps hold items securely while remaining easy to use.
    - Perfect for adding a cute, playful, and personalized touch to everyday organization or decorative display.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and thoughtful personalized gift for kids, teachers, students, friends, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, back-to-school gifts, classroom rewards, party favors, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for school-themed gifts, personalized keepsakes, desk accessories, and decorative event items.
    - A charming gift choice for anyone who loves cute custom accessories and practical decorative pieces.
    - Great for party décor, classroom organization, gift embellishment, and memory keepsakes.
    - Adds a sweet, playful, and personalized touch to any occasion🎁

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Clip

 

PRODUCTION

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
